title: festuca ovina var. crassifolia
intro: Festuca ovina var. crassifolia, commonly known as sheep's fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Festuca ovina var. crassifolia include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
